plugins.photosPermission: Nodo opens your photos so you can attach them to a job.
plugins.cameraPermission: Nodo uses the camera so you can photograph the work on a job.
plugins.microphonePermission: Nodo records sound with the videos you take of a job.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Nodo checks that you are on site when you clock in, and records where you clock out.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: While you are clocked in, Nodo notices when you leave the job and records your route, so your hours show where the day went. Nothing is recorded off the clock.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: While you are clocked in, Nodo notices when you leave the job and records your route, so your hours show where the day went. Nothing is recorded off the clock.
